answer.narration:
"I'll take it." Juno doesn't argue. "Then get some sleep, Spacefarer."

You sleep on a cot in the ridge hab. By morning the crawler has come and gone, and the new strut holds when you lift off. At Bay Nine, Juno hands you the codes to a battered salvage skiff with grapples and a cutting arm. "Bring the skiff back. The money's nice too."

Two days out, the deep belt is dark and quiet. Then the Halcyon slides into your forward view. She's broken in half and tumbling slowly, with glittering debris all around her. The recorder bay is on the aft section, and every eleven seconds it swings past you.
choices: Match her spin and grapple on
Thread the debris toward the stern
Scan the wreck before moving closer

addQuests.detail: Bring back the flight recorder and nav core for forty-five thousand.

answer.summary: Waren Spacefarer, a young pilot, wants forty thousand credits to buy Marta Okafor's Kestrel. He exposed Dren Vasko's people smuggling on the Grubstake, freed eleven refugees and filed an informant claim, but that pays out months from now. He flew Juno Reyes's medicine run to Occator Ridge and owned up to the broken strut, so Juno paid him in full. He took the Halcyon salvage job: the insurer pays forty-five thousand for the wrecked freighter's flight recorder and nav core, and Juno takes ten percent. Flying Juno's salvage skiff, he has reached the tumbling, broken Halcyon in the deep belt.

image.prompt: View from a small salvage skiff cockpit with grapple arms visible: a huge ore freighter broken in half, slowly tumbling among glittering debris and dark asteroids in the deep asteroid belt, distant faint sunlight. A lean young man in his early twenties, short dark brown hair, light stubble, keen grey eyes, worn olive flight jacket over a grey t-shirt, at the controls, seen from behind.
image.fallback: A broken ore freighter split in two tumbling slowly among glittering debris and dark asteroids in deep space, faint distant sunlight, cold and silent.
